items.title: Rational Emotive Behavior Therapy: Origins, Constructs, and Applications
items.rights_note: ERIC full text; useful for historical naming and conceptual overview, not a primary outcome trial.

items.title: Albert Ellis Bibliography — primary REBT works
items.rights_note: Founder institute bibliography identifies early works and naming chronology; it is not the primary texts themselves and does not support substantive theory claims.

items.title: 50 years of rational-emotive and cognitive-behavioral therapy: A systematic review and meta-analysis
items.rights_note: Open synthesis of naming, theory, proposed mechanisms and outcomes; author proximity and study heterogeneity require independent appraisal.

items.title: A systematic review of the nature and efficacy of Rational Emotive Behaviour Therapy interventions
items.rights_note: Open recent review of intervention composition and efficacy; preserves variation in populations, outcomes and study quality.

items.title: Rational Emotive Behavior Therapy in the Context of Modern Psychological Research
items.rights_note: Founder institute's current research framing; evidence of continuation, not independent adjudication.

items.title: Rational emotive behavioural therapy — new studies in the guideline update
items.rights_note: Public NICE guideline evidence table for a depression RCT comparing REBT, cognitive therapy and medication; narrow to that trial and indication.
